parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: The IDs of applications associated with the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 application IDs.

parameters.name: ApplicationType
parameters.description:
The application type for the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Application**: Application.

- **Tag**: Tag.

parameters.name: CustomUserAttributes
parameters.description: This parameter specifies a collection of custom user groups for the private network access policy. It is required when the user group type is **Custom**. This collection is mutually exclusive with the user group ID collection, and you can specify a maximum of 10 custom user groups.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A description of the internal network access policy. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

parameters.name: DeviceAttributeAction
parameters.description:
The action taken when a device does not meet the security baseline. Valid values:

- **Block**: Block access.

- **Observe**: Monitor access.

parameters.name: DeviceAttributeId
parameters.description: The ID of the security baseline policy.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The method used to update the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Cover** (default): Replace the existing application IDs, user group IDs, and custom user attributes with the values specified in **ApplicationIds**, **UserGroupIds**, and **CustomUserAttributes**.

- **Append**: Add the values specified in **ApplicationIds**, **UserGroupIds**, and **CustomUserAttributes** to the existing application IDs, user group IDs, and custom user attributes.

parameters.name: PolicyAction
parameters.description:
The action that the internal network access policy takes. Valid values:

- **Block**: Block access.

- **Allow**: Allow access.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the internal network access policy. Get this value from one of the following operations:

- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): List internal network access policies in batches.

- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an internal network access policy.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the internal network access policy. Priority 1 is the highest. Valid values: 1 to 1000. The maximum value is the total number of internal network access policies minus 1.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The IDs of tags associated with the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 tag IDs.

parameters.name: TriggerTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the trigger template.

parameters.name: TrustedProcessGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of trusted process groups.

parameters.name: TrustedProcessStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the trusted process feature. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: TrustedSoftwareIds
parameters.description: The IDs of trusted software.

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of user groups associated with the internal network access policy. This parameter is required when UserGroupMode is set to Normal. This parameter is mutually exclusive with **CustomUserAttributes**. A single policy supports up to 10,000 user groups. You can update up to 2,000 user group IDs at a time.

parameters.name: UserGroupMode
parameters.description:
The user group type for the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Normal**: Regular user group.

- **Custom**: Custom user group.

parameters.name: ValidFrom
parameters.description: The start time of the zero-trust policy's effective period, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

parameters.name: ValidTimeStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the effective time feature. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: ValidUntil
parameters.description: The end time of the zero-trust policy's effective period, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
